summary: Bind unauthenticated MCP HTTP to a literal loopback IP by default and reject remote, wildcard, and hostname bind addresses.
reason: The MCP HTTP server has no remote authentication, so accepting a wildcard or network address would expose its tools beyond the local machine. Even localhost can resolve to a non-loopback address through local resolver settings.
validated_outcome: Unit tests accept IPv4 and IPv6 literal loopback addresses and reject wildcard, remote, localhost, and other hostname binds.
